lines.text: That sign looks a bit tacky.

data.define: Describes things that look cheap or show poor taste.

example.text: That sign looks a bit tacky.

misuse.why: It insults their taste in their own home.

publish.title: What does "tacky" mean?
publish.value: Tacky = Cheap-looking and in bad style. Example: "That sign looks a bit tacky." (casual English).
